subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — pricing & concession roadmap
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@stratoretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stratoretail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — quick follow up

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the dashboards looked great. Before we move toward procurement I need a clearer picture on two things:

1) Retention pricing: what are the cost implications if we move from 30 -> 90 day trace retention across our fleet?
2) Tracing ingestion SKU: do you have a per-span or per-ingest model? Any volume breakpoints?

We also want to understand how advanced dashboards are packaged — is that a separate SKU or included in a visibility bundle? Our procurement lead is sensitive to per-feature line items.

If possible, can you send a short, line-item workbook and a suggested concession path if we commit to a 12-month Dedicated capacity? We have an internal target of keeping incremental observability spend under 12% of our forecasted inference bill.

Appreciate a short reply and an optional calendar slot for an up-to-30-min call.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Platform PM
Strato Retail
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@stratoretail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — quick follow up

Jordan — great to hear from you. Short answers up front, full workbook attached.

1) Retention: pricing is tiered by average daily trace storage. Moving from 30->90 days roughly triples storage cost, but we recommend a hybrid policy: keep full traces for 30 days, then sampled traces (1-5%) for 90 days. That reduces marginal cost to ~1.6x versus straight 3x. See tab "Retention Scenarios" in the attached workbook.

2) Tracing ingestion: we price by trace-GB ingested per month with breakpoints at 0.5TB, 2TB, and 8TB. For high-volume customers we offer a flat ingest cap (prepaid) which is cheaper than per-GB at scale.

3) Dashboards: Advanced dashboards (custom widgets, cross-model joins, and export bundles) are an add-on SKU but we bundle them into a Visibility Suite at a discounted blended rate.

Concession path for a 12-month Dedicated commit:
- 10% discount on observability add-ons with a 6-month revenue commit
- 18% discount if committed to 12 months + minimum 2TB/day retention footprint
- One-time onboarding credit equal to one month of add-on fees for first-year deals

I attached a pricing workbook (observability_pricing_v2.xlsx) and a tracing SKU draft. Can we do a 30-minute call tomorrow at 10:30am PT to review numbers?

—Sean
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stratoretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — quick follow up

Thanks Sean — the workbook is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from procurement:

- The 18% figure looks promising but we need a clearer service-level commitment for trace-query latency (p99). Can Redwood commit to a p99 query latency SLA for 90-day traces when on Dedicated?
- For the hybrid sampling plan, we need the retention policy enforced server-side (not client sampling). Can you confirm the exact guarantee and how rollbacks/sample-rate changes are handled?

Also, is the onboarding credit applied to the first invoice or credited against the annual commitment?

If we sign to a 12-month deal with the 18% discount, procurement will want a clear price table separated by feature (retention, ingest, advanced dashboards) — we prefer not to have blended line items to make internal chargebacks easier.

Elena
Procurement Lead
Strato Retail

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stratoretail.com>, Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@stratoretail.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — quick follow up

Elena / Jordan — thanks for the thoughtful questions; we can do everything you've asked, with a couple of practical notes below.

- SLA: We can include a p99 trace-query latency commitment on Dedicated for 90-day retention. We'll define the exact p99 target in the SOW; typical target is 800ms p99 for standard queries and 2500ms for long historical scans. We will include an operational playbook for escalation.

- Server-side retention policy: confirmed. Sampling is enforced server-side after ingestion; you can adjust sample rates via the Console API and we retain a change log for audit and rollback for 90 days.

- Onboarding credit: applied as a line credit against your first invoice after provisioning (not against the committed ARR). If you prefer the credit to offset the annual commitment directly we can accommodate that, but procurement should note it changes the invoicing profile.

- Line-item pricing: we can provide both a blended Visibility Suite row and a fully broken-out table for internal chargebacks. We'll surface both in the updated workbook.

Next steps:
1) Sean: update the pricing workbook to include a separated price table plus an appendix with the SLA targets and sample policy.
2) Marissa: I'll need a short SOW sketch (1-2 pages) that captures the p99 numbers and credit mechanics so procurement can review.
3) Jordan / Elena: confirm whether you want the onboarding credit applied to the first invoice or to the ARR allocation.

I can meet Tue 17 Jun at 10am PT for a final run-through — propose we lock the discount at 18% pending procurement sign-off and legal review.

—Vanessa
Head of Commercials, Americas
Redwood Inference
